explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/61 (Erdős–Hajnal): Erdős and Hajnal proved that every induced-H-free G on n vertices has a clique or independent set of size ≥ exp(c_H √log n). IsErdosHajnalLowerBound encodes the induced-H-free condition via embeddings g with H = G.comap g, and the clique/independence conclusion, eventually in n. Faithful.
